references.use: 主要画风与配色；不复制游戏布置/符号

prompt:
Create a NEW original illustrated interior background for a commercial anime RPG, using the attached Girls' Frontline 2 room as the MAIN painting and colour reference. Study its nuanced warm/cool greys, grey-green environmental colour, diffuse localised light, believable soft textiles and matte metal, natural edge variation and lived-in atmosphere. Repaint from scratch, not a cleaned-up architectural render. Do not copy the game's exact room, furniture, signs, labels, logos or black borders.

An inhabited small expedition camp OUTSIDE a winter city, approximately a century in the future. Refined postmodern civilian modular furnishings, a few broad matte insulated wall planes, minimal seams, subtle rounded/chamfered practical silhouettes. A believable human working/living place. Landscape 16:9, seated eye-level view with real near/middle/far perspective. Crucial framing: a LARGE upholstered charcoal-grey chair very close at the LEFT, with its armrest projecting diagonally toward the lower centre and a plain dark jacket loosely draped over its back. The near chair forms a strong soft-edged foreground silhouette, not a little desk chair. Beyond it in the MIDDLE LEFT/CENTRE: a wide genuinely usable 1.8m planning desk with clear legs and knee space, a compatible working chair slightly pulled aside. On the desk are a spread map with an open document folio, one compact communication terminal, one functional task lamp and one used mug; group these around the worker's reach and leave free tabletop. The work surface has the sharpest selective detail.

REAR RIGHT: one low closed wall cabinet, two identical slate-grey equipment cases secured together inside a lower storage bay, one small water dispenser and thermos tray above. Along the RIGHT wall a human-scale built-in fold-down single berth with a softly rumpled muted rust-grey blanket and pillow. One small enclosed contemporary fireplace near the front-right, substantially separated from bedding by clear floor and a blank fireproof partition. Leave a generous clear walking route between desk and living zone. Furniture rests on the same consistent floor; sensible ground contact, chair clearance, power connection and no floating objects. A wide but secondary rear window admits overcast winter daylight: snow outdoors and only a few almost imperceptible grey-blue silhouettes of a distant modern city. No mountains, individual trees or detailed city windows. Exterior is a quiet low-contrast atmosphere patch.

Borrow the reference's COLOUR LOGIC and PAINTING: neutral stone-grey, softly varied grey-green and muted grey-teal dominate the interior, graphite-blue dark fabric, off-white desk and bedding, small faded terracotta textile accent. Cool grey-blue appears mainly outside and in reflected shadows. A little warm-white task light and a small amber hearth, not a yellow cast across every surface. Comfortable middle values, diffuse light and coloured reflected shadow, softly painted cloth folds, restrained selective edge highlights on metal, rough-to-soft brush transitions at nonfocal edges. Floor is quiet matte grey with a few broad perspective planes, no reflection or detailed texture. This should read as a lovingly art-directed PAINTED GAME BACKGROUND with natural material response, not uniformly smooth CG, cel-flat plastic furniture, gritty photograph or line-perfect showroom. Detail concentrated around the worker's use area; near chair and far storage are quieter. Calm believable personal use, no clutter inflation. No people, text, UI, logo, emblem, meaningless symbol, arm patch, poster, plants, flags, decorative books, weapon rack, neon, dangling cables, patterned rug or snow indoors.
